description: PrometheusRuleSpec contains the specification of desired alerting/recording rule groups. See https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator/blob/main/Documentation/api-reference/api.md#monitoring.coreos.com/v1.PrometheusRuleSpec

groups.description: Content of Prometheus rule file. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/alerting_rules/

items.description: RuleGroup is a list of sequentially evaluated recording and alerting rules.

interval.description: Interval determines how often rules in this group are evaluated. Defaults to global.evaluation_interval.

limit.description: Limit the number of alerts an alerting rule and series a recording rule can produce.

partial_response_strategy.description: PartialResponseStrategy is only used by ThanosRuler. See https://github.com/thanos-io/thanos/blob/main/docs/components/rule.md#partial-response

query_offset.description: Defines the offset the rule evaluation timestamp of this particular group by the specified duration into the past.

rules.description: List of alerting and recording rules.

items.description: Rule describes an alerting or recording rule. See https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/alerting_rules/ or https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/recording_rules/#recording-rules for documentation.

alert.description: Name of the alert. Must be a valid label value.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to each alert. Only valid for alerting rules.

for.description: Alerts are considered firing once they have been returned for this long. Only valid for alerting rules.

keep_firing_for.description: KeepFiringFor defines how long an alert will continue firing after the condition that triggered it has cleared.

record.description: Name of the time series to output to. Must be a valid metric name. Only valid for recording rules.
